def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    filtered_people = []
    for person in people:
        if person.verify_property("person", "sunglasses"):
            if not person.verify_property("person", "blue scarf"):
                filtered_people.append(person)
    
    if not filtered_people: return image_patch

    return smiling_people[0]
